The article discusses a luminous phenomenon identified as the orbital module of China's Shenzhou 15 spacecraft by astrophysicist and satellite tracker Jonathan McDowell. The article mentions that this module was launched in November 2022 and contributed to the operations of China's Tiangong space station.
